A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, Controllable Context Sensitivity and the Knob Behind It. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–I support reliable comparison, including matching relocated plots.

before.justification: v2 reports original fine-tuning, in-context learning, activation-patching, and subspace-steering experiments for Llama-3.1, Mistral-v0.3, and Gemma-2.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical evaluations and reports revised layer-search and ablation results in Figures 2, 6, and 7.

M1.justification: Listing 1 changes the lower-bound search loop condition from '< thres' to '>= thres' and its default threshold from 0.85 to 0.88. These are limited corrections to the documented search procedure, not merely expanded explanation. The two-stage search framework and rank-1 subspace learning and steering method remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use CCS-BF, CCS-MH, and CCS-AR with the same instruction and numerical-weight intent formats. Revised layer-patching experiments do not introduce additional datasets, tasks, or populations.

E2.justification: The zero-shot, in-context learning, fine-tuned, and unsteered intent-instruction comparators remain unchanged across the corresponding model and dataset evaluations.

E3.justification: v3 explicitly replaces manually selected patching settings in Figure 2b–d with algorithm-selected settings and revises the intervention subsets in Appendix A. Listing 1 also reports a higher selection threshold. Benchmark splits, accuracy metrics, model sizes, and training budgets are unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 7 revises the layer-24 omission test from L25–L31 to L15–L23 plus L25 and L30, and the restricted prior-answer test from L13–L16 to L15–L16. Its three additional panels preserve earlier main-text results as alternative solutions; they are not entirely new analyses.

E5.justification: Mean/median curves, shaded-band displays, and correlation/significance reporting retain the same practices. v3 adds no repeated-run counts, seed information, or new uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: Figures 2, 6, and 7 contain revised probability trajectories and layer-localization results. For example, Figure 2b changes from L12–L16 to L13–L15, and Figure 2d from L24–L31 to L15–L25 plus L30. These involve different interventions, not same-setting performance gains. Earlier manual results are retained in Figure 7; benchmark and steering results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The formal task definitions, pair-accuracy metric, projection decomposition, training objective, and steering equations remain unchanged, as do the projection explanations in Appendices F–G. No theoretical result or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and concluding discussion retain the same contributions: controllable context sensitivity, linear-time layer search, and a transferable one-dimensional steering subspace. Revised localization evidence does not change these core claims.

C2.justification: Appendix A.2 newly emphasizes that multiple layer sets can achieve the same intervention goal. Section 4.3 presents late-only context patching as an alternative solution, while Appendix A.2 replaces the specific interpretation about prior-answer layers 17–18 with a broader statement about layers after 16. Section 6's limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Listing 1 supplies corrected search pseudocode and a revised threshold. The new Section 4.3 footnote discloses that earlier Figure 2b–d settings were found manually rather than by Listing 1. Training hyperparameters, projection implementation details, prompt examples, and the code-access statement remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, bibliography, and positioning relative to prior research are unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites affect Section 4.3 and Appendix A.2, with an explanatory correction footnote and an acknowledgement for identifying the Listing 1 typo. The overall narrative and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 6 update plotted interventions and panel labels. Figure 7 expands from two to five panels, incorporating three relocated main-text plots; its caption is shortened. A red correction footnote and limited appendix reflow accompany these localized display changes.

improvement.justification: v3 improves transparency and reproducibility by correcting Listing 1, distinguishing manually selected results from algorithm outputs, and retaining the earlier plots for inspection. Recognizing alternative layer sets also qualifies the localization interpretation. The gain is limited: benchmark and steering evidence are unchanged, and some prose remains inconsistent with updated figures—for example, Appendix B still describes seven patched layers although Figure 6d now shows L15–L21 plus L24.
